name: Pranav Patil
headline: I build the lending and payments systems behind Retail and SME credit at *Wio Bank* — and the *multi-agent AI* that investigates production incidents when they break.
bio: I care most about the decision behind a system: who it's for, what breaks without it, and which constraint you refuse to trade away. I'm moving toward *product roles where AI is the product, not the garnish*.

seo.title: Pranav Patil — Engineer building AI and fintech products
seo.description: Software engineer at Wio Bank building lending and payments systems, and WioGenie — a multi-agent AI incident investigator with citation-backed reasoning.
